description_excerpt: Your responsibilities • Manage DB health and services (PostgreSQL first, also Oracle and MongoDB) to ensure the highest standards of availability, resilience, integrity, security, tuning, and performance, backups and recovery plans. • Participate in transformation and architecture projects, related to AWS, OCI Cloud. • Execute disaster recovery plans and procedures to ensure database availability during system outages or dysfunction. • Support development teams on database aspects. • Join operations sessions with customers for live monitoring, troubleshooting, fine-tuning production…
